corrections.reason: The Ge'ez root quote from Luke 10:31 ('passed by him') is printed as ወተዓደዎ (with ዓ and ዎ), which Stage 1 misread as ወተዳደቁ.
The image shows the 4th-order ባ in ባቀረበው ('by the sacrifice which he offered', parallel to ባቀረቡት in line 38), where the shortened left leg of ባ was misread as 1st-order በ.
The printed Ge'ez verb is ወጸዓኖ (with 4th-order ዓ, 'and set him on'), where ዓ was misread as አ.
Visually and grammatically the text reads በጰራቅሊጦስ ('by the Paraclete bringing forth Old and New Testaments...'), where the initial በ was misread as የ.
